runs.summary: I updated T-005's spec and done_when so the rotation also covers the Dodo webhook secret stored in the centre Worker, which belongs to the disabled staging endpoint. T-005 stays in queue until after launch, R-835b0027 is acked and the change is committed.

decisions.why: Adi set the rule on 2026-09-18 (memory owner-launch-constraints): no Dodo rotation until every task is done, after launch, and it must not be raised before then. Tasks are still open (T-004 review, T-087, T-241 queue). Rotating creates credentials in Dodo, which only Adi can do.

decisions.decision: Build everything except the vendor-side rotation. 1) Prepare the steps so rotation takes minutes: confirm the app/.env.local variable names (DODO_API_KEY, DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET), the Worker secret name and `wrangler secret put` command for revops-centre, and that probe-workshop.mjs and a signed-test-event script for /hooks/dodo are ready. 2) Do not touch the Dodo dashboard, since creating or rotating credentials is reserved. 3) After Adi supplies the new values, write them to .env.local, set the Worker secret to the live endpoint's own secret, restart the dev server, run probe-workshop.mjs and send a signed test event to /hooks/dodo. Keep T-005 as the last task and do not rotate earlier.
decisions.why: T-005 spec and the owner-launch-constraints rule make Dodo key rotation the final post-launch task. Creating or rotating credentials is reserved for Adi. The launch cohort (7 to 9 Oct) has passed.
